connection.label: A partner-built integration on Adobe's Commerce integration starter kit (App Builder) passes customers and orders between Commerce and the CRM
connection.how: The partner builds this on Adobe's Commerce integration starter kit, which runs in Adobe Developer App Builder. Commerce sends customer and order events through Adobe I/O Events to App Builder actions that transform the data and call the CRM's APIs. In the other direction, the CRM publishes events (or calls the kit's ingestion webhook) and actions update customers and order status in Commerce through the Commerce APIs.
connection.gain_title: Customers and orders shared with the CRM
connection.gain_text: Your client's sales and service teams see Commerce customers and their orders in the CRM, and customer changes made in the CRM reach Commerce, without manual re-entry.
prereqs: Adobe Developer App Builder access for your client's organization, with a project created from the App Builder template
I/O Events, I/O Management API and Adobe I/O Events for Adobe Commerce added to the App Builder workspace (plus the Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service API on Commerce as a Cloud Service)

Adobe Commerce on cloud infrastructure or on-premises: an integration created in the Commerce Admin for its keys and tokens, the Adobe I/O Events modules installed on Commerce 2.4.4 and 2.4.5, and cron enabled so Commerce sends events
Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service: OAuth server-to-server credentials from the Adobe Developer Console
Commerce eventing 1.12.1 or higher for starter kit version 3.0.0 or later
API access and credentials for the CRM from your client's CRM administrator, and agreement on which system owns each customer and order field

flows.what: Customer save and delete events and order save events, transformed and sent to the CRM's APIs
Customer creates, updates and deletes and order status updates, written to Commerce through its APIs

connection.sow_how: We will build a custom integration between Adobe Commerce and your CRM on Adobe's Commerce integration starter kit, which runs in Adobe Developer App Builder. Commerce will send customer and order events to the integration, which will transform them and call your CRM's APIs. Customer changes and order status updates from your CRM will be written back to Commerce through its APIs.
connection.sow_gain: Your sales and service teams will see Commerce customers and their orders in the CRM, and customer changes made in the CRM will reach Commerce, without manual re-entry.

evidence.quote: Integrating Adobe Commerce with your Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Order Management System (OMS), or Customer Relationship Management (CRM) is now easier with Adobe Commerce integration starter kit.
It includes reference integrations for commonly used Commerce data like orders, products, and customers.
The integration starter kit is designed to work with all Adobe Commerce versions, but only one at a time.
The integration starter kit provides packages for Commerce products, customers, orders, shipments, and stocks and their external back office counterparts.
By default, object synchronization is bi-directional.
